items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: That was my professor. He teached me eyes and bones, pure ants and all of us.

ctx.x: And he played with your brass band and then did he also play with the string band? Yeah. He played with the string band too. Yeah. Yeah. And uh.
Professor Humphrey always said, actually a little friend then, he wished he had everybody like that had the brains what he had.
He was a kind of a star pupil.
